briefing.text:
- Incident near Altadena is at 120.0 km², having grown 12.0 km² in the last hour.
- Current weather shows winds from 201 degrees at 3.1 km/h with gusts to 42.8 km/h, 21% humidity, and 11.1°C temperature.
- EVACUATE: Pasadena (137,195 residents, ETA 0h), Altadena (42,846 residents, ETA 0h), and Sierra Madre (10,775 residents, ETA 0h); total 190,816 residents under evacuation.
- WARNING: 12 towns under warning representing 463,364 residents with an ETA of 1h.
- Forecast limits: satellite pixels are 2-4 km; smoke and night can hide fire.
